about: Triage of batch n5 (Nibbāna, Emulate round 3), after the fresh reader of REVIEW.md: what went in and why. Each change to Emulate's words is also in emulate_n5.py, SPLICES[...]["mine"], with its reason.

items.decision: in as sample bz wrote it: "That leads to a practical problem."

items.review: CHANGED (minor): "In several suttas, most notably" adds a claim; "the Dhamma that leads to opening" one step more indirect than "the teaching that opens"
items.decision: in, with the added claim cut ("In DN 3 and MN 56, the Buddha does not teach ..."); "the Dhamma that leads to opening the Dhamma-eye" stays Emulate's: the special teaching is what the Dhamma-eye opens after, and putting his words back would rebuild the sentence that read AI, Medium

items.review: CHANGED (minor): the map image and "the answer" lost; "in a way that allows" implies a layout choice
items.decision: in, with "to the answer" back ("... allows anyone to skip ahead to the answer?"); the section's heading names the map, and the article itself argues that how a map is presented matters (readiness warnings, anti-counterfeit framing), so "lay out the stages in a way that allows" says what he says

items.review: CHANGED (minor): "everywhere they touched" narrowed "connected everywhere"; "This was not one experience" separates what his sentence joined (connected without becoming one)
items.decision: in, with "connected everywhere" back; "This was not one experience, nor was it one scene being seen by a witness." stays Emulate's: right after "connected everywhere" it still says the connection didn't make one experience, and read as the whole event it says the same thing he says
